text:
jess: hey team, kicking off the GCP account + VPC scaffold for eu-west4. scope: new cluster with GPU capacity (A100), private control plane, shared VPC with prod and staging projects. tagging owners and asking for runbook review :wave:

eric: nice. quick checklist before we start?

maria: please include quota requests for GPUs + internal IPs, and a note about reserved ranges for nodepools. last time we ran out of /24s.

jess: agreed. initial plan: 1) create org project (redwood-eu4-infra), 2) enable required APIs, 3) service accounts + IAM, 4) shared VPC host + attach prod/staging service projects, 5) subnets per zone, 6) firewall + routes, 7) NAT + Cloud DNS, 8) test peering and egress, 9) request GPU quota, 10) handoff.

eric: call out specifics: use /20 for shared VPC with subdivided /24 subnets per zone. reserve two /24s per zone for kube-nodepools and one /26 for bastion.

jess: copying recommended CIDR plan: 10.40.0.0/20 host VPC -> zones eu-west4-a/b/c. subnets: 10.40.0.0/24 eu-west4-a-app, 10.40.1.0/24 eu-west4-b-app, 10.40.2.0/24 eu-west4-c-app, 10.40.10.0/24 staging, 10.40.20.0/26 bastion. docs: we will avoid overlapping with customer VPN ranges.

samuel: adding cost note: single NAT gateway per region costs ~0.05 USD/hr + egress. consider Cloud NAT rather than per-VM. for GPU nodes, use preemptible A100s where appropriate to save ~60% but ensure burst capacity for reserved workloads.

maria: also check placement constraints: some providers limit A100 count per zone; prefer spreading across zones to avoid soft quotas. we'll need to file a quota increase for GPUs and CPUs. include link to quota form in the runbook.

jess: terraform snippet for shared VPC host project (draft):
```hcl
resource "google_compute_network" "shared_vpc" {
  name                    = "redwood-eu4-shared-vpc"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
  routing_mode            = "REGIONAL"
}

resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "eu4_a_app" {
  name          = "eu4-a-app"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.40.0.0/24"
  region        = "europe-west4"
  network       = google_compute_network.shared_vpc.self_link
}
```

eric: for IAM, minimal roles: compute.networkAdmin on host, serviceAccountUser for node pools, dns.admin for Cloud DNS entries. lock down project-level owner to cloudfoundation group.

samuel: validation checklist to run after infra apply:
- gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu4-infra (confirm roles)
- gcloud compute networks describe redwood-eu4-shared-vpc (confirm subnets and routing_mode)
- gcloud compute addresses list --region europe-west4 (check reserved internal IPs)
- kubectl run --image=nginx test-pod --requests=cpu=250m (sanity for cluster nodes)

jess: adding commands to verify VPC peering and DNS resolution:
```bash
# from jump host
dig +short host.prod.internal.svc.cluster.local @10.40.10.2
# check route to public internet
traceroute -n 8.8.8.8
```

maria: ops-bot, can you add a ticket in infra-board for the GPU quota increase and tag cloud-ops?

ops-bot: created INFRA-7123: "eu-west4 GPU quota increase (A100)" assigned to @eric, due 2026-04-03. :white_check_mark:

eric: filed the support ticket with GCP, request ID: gcp-req-82591. ETA 3-5 business days. included justification: production ML training + inference pools + fallback to preemptible.

samuel: reminder: enable Private Service Connect for control plane reachability if we go private GKE. avoids NAT for control-plane to node communications.

jess: handoff steps for oncall and SRE:
1) Confirm quota approvals and seed 1 nodepool with 1 A100 preemptible + 3 standard nodes.
2) Run synthetic inference load to validate latency and KV cache behavior.
3) Observe mesh and egress costs for first 72 hours.
4) Open a post-handoff slack thread with metrics: token/sec, p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens.

maria: oncall-gcp-bot, please schedule a daily health check job for 7 days post-handoff (pod restarts, network errors, CPU steal on GPUs).

oncall-gcp-bot: scheduled daily-health-check-eu-west4 at 08:00 UTC for 7 days. Reports will be posted to #eng-sre.

eric: one more: export terraform state to our remote backend and encrypt the state with KMS key tied to the infra project. don't store state locally.

jess: tagging this thread as the canonical runbook draft for eu-west4 account and VPC scaffold. I'll create the docs PR and handover ticket once quota and KMS are confirmed. thanks all :rocket:
